title: Sources: Bret Taylor's Sierra is in talks to raise ~$1.5B at a ~$30B valuation, up from $15.8B in May; it said in October it hit $400M+ in annualized revenue (The Information)
summary: The Information: Sources: Bret Taylor's Sierra is in talks to raise ~$1.5B at a ~$30B valuation, up from $15.8B in May; it said in October it hit $400M+ in annualized revenue — Sierra, the AI customer support startup founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, has been in talks to raise new funding …
